fuel.method: 12-month log change in motor-fuel consumer prices on the 12-month log change in Brent (US$), 2009-01 to 2025-12, Newey-West errors over 12 months; range is 90%
fuel.brent: FRED MCOILBRENTEU (Brent, monthly average, US$), fetched 2026-10-25
fuel.prices: Eurostat HICP, prc_hicp_minr (ECOICOP 2; all items, food CP01, motor fuels CP0722, electricity CP0451, gas CP0452), fetched 2026-10-25; US: BLS CPI via FRED, seasonally adjusted (CPIAUCSL, CPIUFDSL, CUSR0000SETB, CUSR0000SEHF01, CUSR0000SEHF02), fetched 2026-10-24 to 2026-10-25; elsewhere: OECD Data Explorer, DF_PRICES_ALL (national CPIs, CP0722), fetched 2026-10-25; SingStat Table Builder API (M213751 series 1.06.1.5), fetched 2026-10-25; Statistics Canada Web Data Service (v41691136), fetched 2026-10-25

pooled.what: median of the national slopes, for reference (a country without a series has no estimate); the range is their middle half

USA.series: US CPI motor fuel (BLS via FRED)

prices.source: FAOSTAT consumer price indices (general and food, 2015 = 100, monthly), fetched 2026-10-25
prices.method: h-month log change in the price index on the h-month log change in Brent (FRED MCOILBRENTEU, US$), 2009-01 to 2025-12, Newey-West errors over h months; each country's slope is ridge-updated towards our cost-of-living model's link (US, UK and euro-area average, normal regime) by its noise, the penalty set by how far the countries' true slopes spread around the model; inflation is the 12-month change in the index, at the latest month and in Feb 2026 before the closure
prices.outlook: the latest 12 months' inflation continues, plus the country's oil link applied to Brent's known move since the latest price month; 90% band from this country's past misses of that rule (12-month forecasts from every 6 months, 2015-2024), scaled by the square root of the horizon

food.what: 12-month-ahead error of the time-series model against 'the last 12 months' inflation continues', origins every 6 months 2015-2024

all.what: 12-month-ahead error of the time-series model against 'the last 12 months' inflation continues', origins every 6 months 2015-2024

trade.source: UN Comtrade, public preview API (HS 2709 crude and HS 2710 refined products, imports CIF and exports FOB as each country reports them, US$)
trade.notes: gulf_share: imports from the seven Gulf producers / all oil imports, an upper bound for oil through the strait (Yanbu and Fujairah bypass it); m: net oil imports / oil imports
